quotes.text: We booked a two hour watersports adventure with Captain Jon, aka Mr. Boatman per my niece:) We had a great time, he was professional, yet fun, joking and interacting with myself and the 5 kids I brought on board. Would definitely do it again for a longer adventure!
We had a great time tubing with Jon. All 3 teenage kids and both adults enjoyed everything about the trip. Boat was very nice and he hooked up our daughter’s music. Would highly recommend.

quotes.author: CB
quotes.text: Highlight of our trip! The boat was beautiful, the staff courteous and knowledgeable. The look of joy and happiness on the kids’ faces made it worth every penny. Highly recommend!
I'm a repeat customer and have always had great experiences using VA Beach Watersports. My kids still talk about Capt. John and his boat. I can't wait to do it again.

quotes.text: Excellent trip with Captain Jon and four twenties/teens. Had a blast! Boat is beautiful and Captain Jon made the day fun for all. Worth every penny!
